column3: The operation is necessary, and this speaker is able to function adequately.
GARDEVOIR: Oh? Does that mean you don't enjoy the work?
FLORINIA: Enjoyment is a triviality.
Only function matters.
GARDEVOIR: How boring!
Surely there must be something you enjoy doing, Florinia?
FLORINIA: Personal emotion is too confounding of a condition to reach that assumption safely.
And misinterpretation of human emotion can lead to severe risk.
This writer has already lost too much at its hand; thus, as logically directed, the risk is avoided.
GARDEVOIR: Oh my, this is juicy!
So you were hurt by someone in the past and that's why you ignore your emotions-- is that what I'm understanding?
FLORINIA: That is a sufficent abstract, yes.
GARDEVOIR: Lovely! Do tell, what happened?
FLORINIA: The conclusion will not be forthcoming.
The previous analysis is sufficient.
Good bye.
GARDEVOIR: What? I say when the interview ends, not you!
Darn it! This was finally getting good!
I'm here right now with someone very special to me personally.
Say hello to Reborn's Ice Gym Leader and former model, Serra Voclain!
SERRA: Goodness, Gardevoir, this is a surprise.
I assumed you'd come back home to collect your belongings, not for this.
GARDEVOIR: What's the matter? You seem almost disappointed!
SERRA: No, not in the least.
Neither by the interview nor by you not collecting your things.
Lord knows no one else is using those rooms.
It's just been a long time since I've had a public interview.
It's not a feeling I'd expected to miss.
GARDEVOIR: That's right, you gave up your career for your son before. Do you regret doing that?
SERRA: It's hard to say.
I think the best way to put it is-- although I do feel remorse for what I've lost, I wouldn't change my decision even if I could.
There are more important things than passions and careers.
GARDEVOIR: You mean your son, of course. How touching!
But, tell me, how do you respond to the recent developments wherein he's fallen in with the terrorist organization Team Meteor?
SERRA: I'm sorry.
He's what?
GARDEVOIR: In his recent exploits, it seems likely he's been working under and assisting Team Meteor in destroying the region!
SERRA: He's--
...Gardevoir, take me to Bennett.
GARDEVOIR: Ah, in time, but let's finish the interview first?
SERRA: Gardevoir.
Take me to Bennett.
GARDEVOIR: ...Yes, missus.
I'm here today at the homestead and gymstead of one of Reborn's most popular Trainers, Ms. Amaria Fiore!
Unfortunately, and in a surprise twist for our Interview Intermission, Amaria is actually not available for comment right now...
...seeing as she is currently setting up for battle!
There's been quite a lot going on in this bubbly beauty's life, but luckily, your truest friend, Gossip Gardevoir, is here to catch up to speed.
See, after a recent accident of questionably self- inflicted causes, Ms. Fiore here has developed a sudden textbook case of retrograde amnesia,
And as such has forgotten everything that's occurred in recent events, including things that should have been precious to her and her loved ones.
The battle that's taking place today is not between her and a challenger, but between her and a representative of the Reborn League,
To assess if she is still able to retain her position despite her condition!
Everything is on the line for Amaria today! If it proves that her battling ability went down the drain with her memory, she could find herself out of a job in a snap!
Let's cut to the battlefield now and see how she's doing!
Oh, there's nothing happening? Have they not started yet?
...What do you mean, they already finished!?
I was still giving the intro! What kind of battle was that?!
O-oh. I... I see.
Well, folks,
In a turn of events that is at once altogether unsurprising yet unexpected,
In the time it took me to preface the battle, Amaria has already beaten her opponent for a flawless six-zero shutout victory!
Gotta hand it to the woman of the water, she sure knows how to cling onto her talent even when she loses everything else!
And that, my dear viewers, is exactly proof as to why she is one of Reborn's most famous Gym Leaders!
Today we're meeting Julia Wilde in a quaint cafe to get a bite-- and a scoop.
Here she comes now--
She strolls through the door, swag in every step and saffron seifuku in full bloom,
She rocks a pair of shades like it's nobody's business and they just have to deal with it.
The girl's got style, the girl's got class, she's coming this way--
...And she crashed.
Julia, helloooo? I'm over here!
JULIA: Huh...
GARDEVOIR: Just where were you looking?! You walked right into that table!
JULIA: Oh... Good morning...
GARDEVOIR: Wait, were you wearing those shades just to hide the fact that your eyes were closed as you were walking?!
JULIA: Well, duh... How else am I gonna sleepwalk without anyone noticing?
GARDEVOIR: I'm not so sure that's quite how sleepwalking works, dear.
JULIA: Hey, who's the expert here? You or me?
I don't see you sleepwalking into any tables!
GARDEVOIR: As if I would!
So much for class... Go on, pick up that chair and sit down.
So, Julia, I understand you have somewhat of a fixation with blowing things up.
JULIA: It's just a hobby!
GARDEVOIR: Could you tell us how that got started?
JULIA: Yeah!
Okay, so, when I was younger, I dated this guy named Rod-- actually, was it Rod? Maybe that was Ringo... I always get them mixed up. Anyways--
So, we were out at the park this one time and he keeps like, checking his phone, right? So, at one point he steps into the restroom and I check it too,
To like, see what was so important that he was taking time away from me-- anyway, it turned out he was texting this other girl, and you know,
There's really only one logical thing to do in a situation like that, right?
Which is to open up his phone and change around a couple wires and have a Pokémon jolt up the battery, just to make it glitch out, give a little spook, right?
I mean, that's what anyone would do.
So, he gets back from the bathroom and starts up the phone and he doesn't expect a thing, but I'm just sitting there like ":3c"
And then, suddenly the whole device sparks and the screen melts and he screams and throws it away and it hits a wall and BOOM!
I hadn't felt that excited in years!
Like, blowing things up is WAY more fun than guys.
But if you COMBINE the two, it's even better!
Not that I'm trying to blow any guys up... But you know, the look on their faces is just priceless!
GARDEVOIR: I'm... sure it is.
Listen, have you considered professional therapy?
JULIA: Therapy? Me?
Oh, no, I'm not really good at giving advice and helping people. I'm flattered you think so though!
Anyway, I thought the whole kaboom-thing might come up today,
So I prepared a demonstration!
Do you wanna see?
GARDEVOIR: NO.
-beep-
GARDEVOIR: Uh.
Today I'm here in Calcenon City to interview the smoldering beauty famed for the flames-- Charlotte Belrose!
Charlotte, thanks for taking the time to talk to me today.
CHARLOTTE: Sure thing, Gardevoir. In fact, I should be thanking you.
We're in ground zero and things are about as boring as they can be up here.
It's always a pleasure to take some time out of my day to embarrass someone on public TV.
GARDEVOIR: That's-- No, wait, that's my job.
CHARLOTTE: By 'someone' I meant myself.
GARDEVOIR: Oh! Well, no need to be embarrassed, darling.
I must admit, you didn't seem like the shy type.
CHARLOTTE: I'm not.
GARDEVOIR: Well-- okay.
Whatever the case, don't worry, I'm sure you'll do fine!
CHARLOTTE: I'm not worried either.
I wasn't even serious about embarrassing myself.
But it's nice that you try and think of the comfort levels of your guests once in a while.
GARDEVOIR: Of course! That's just what a good hostess should-- Wait, what do you mean, "Once in a while"?
CHARLOTTE: I've seen your past interviews.
You normally just act all high and mighty while you put someone else on blast.
Am I wrong?
GARDEVOIR: Of course you're wrong!
CHARLOTTE: That's funny, because I distinctly remember you tearing into Aya in a previous episode.
Threatening to tell the world about her relationship?
That doesn't seem very courteous to me.
GARDEVOIR: She called the police!
CHARLOTTE: You're right, that was rude of her.
Almost as rude as you being in her house without permission.
GARDEVOIR: And still not half as rude as you're being right now!
CHARLOTTE: Oh, you're right.
My apologies, Gardevoir, I thought that you would be more supportive of your fans who've watched so many of your past TV appearances.
I guess this is just how much we mean to you though.
GARDEVOIR: That's not what I'm saying! Ugh!
CHARLOTTE: You've got such a short fuse. Do you really get along well with the sponsors this way?
GARDEVOIR: That's none of your business!
CHARLOTTE: Do you want to know what I think?
I think you're lying.
GARDEVOIR: Lying?
Okay, sure, this sounds good.
Tell me, almighty, wise Charlotte.
What am I lying about?
CHARLOTTE: You're lying to yourself.
You know the truth about why this show is funded.
It's because you're a character.
GARDEVOIR: A character? Like in a game or something? That's ridiculous.
CHARLOTTE: You're sold to the public masses as a foolish, incompetent reporter character.
The only value in these interviews comes from your buffoonery.
Why else wouldn't it be edited out?
But you have this egocentric streak that lashes back when prodded.
If you were really playing a character, you wouldn't be so sensitive.
You'd have an understanding that the you on TV is different than who you really are.
But you don't.
Because you're every bit as impulsive and incompetent as you appear.
But the worst part is,
You won't admit it even when you know it.
Even if you're impulsive, you're not so stupid as to not have thought about your own shows.
You realized that you were just being used and made fun of, but you wanted to believe you were actually a famous person people cared about.
So you've been playing make-believe with your own success this whole time.
GARDEVOIR: That's nonsense...
CHARLOTTE: Is it?
Look me in the eyes and tell me I'm wrong.
We're here today with one of Reborn's Elite Four...
She's powerful...
She's ferocious...
And she's four feet and three inches of pure battling skill!
Let's hear it for Heather Molinar!
Heather, thanks so much for joining us on the show!
HEATHER: Thanks for having me, Gardevoir!
It's a nice change for someone to recognize strength when they see it!
GARDEVOIR: Those are some mighty words for such a tiny person!
But certainly your status threatens to back those words up nicely.
Can you tell us where you think your strength comes from?
HEATHER: Well, obviously, it comes from my Pokémon.
And...
I guess, my friends too.
GARDEVOIR: Your friends? Whoever could you mean?
HEATHER: Well, there were a couple Trainers who wanted to help me out after I ran away from home.
Cain, even though he's weird.
And \PN keeps showing up everywhere...
Even I know things wouldn't have worked out this well without them.
But mostly...
I mean my friend, Shelly.
We met after I got mad at my dad and took off for a few days before.
She hid me in her Gym and we had a lot of fun playing together...
Well, I had fun, at least.
I guess we just always did what I wanted.
But she was there to help me after things got bad too.
I guess she liked me too, for whatever reason.
I don't really get it, but...
I wanna try and make it back up to her.
She was really nice to me and I was selfish.
So I gotta be a good friend from now on, too.
GARDEVOIR: Admirable words from someone who's been through so much!
It seems like this young Trainer has really found the resolve to grow!
I wonder what that could mean for the future of this battler, too!
Any certain Trainers out there looking to face the Elite Four soon may just want to watch out!
HEATHER: Obviously! It's just cuz I'm the princess of the wind!
GARDEVOIR: The princess of the wind? However do you mean?
HEATHER: My Mom was a Flying-type Trainer too, so that's kind of like being the wind!
I learned what I could from how she used to battle, and now I'm even stronger than she was!
GARDEVOIR: Oh my, even stronger? That's quite a claim!
HEATHER: But it's true! Cuz she only used Pokémon she thought were cute...
Like Salamence!
Okay, so it's not exactly the usual "cute"-- but that shouldn't be the determining factor!
As a top tier battler, I'm not afraid to use the big, powerful ones!
Everyone's always like "Whaaat? Why would a little girl want a Pokémon like that?"
And they try to pass me off with Buneary or Pikachu or some other crap Fairy trash just because it's pink.
Who cares about any of that?!
I don't need to look cute, I need to kick butt!
And that's exactly what I'm gonna do!
GARDEVOIR: That's quite the fighting spirit!
And there you have it, folks-- a girl who's not afraid to take on the whole world with the help of her Pokémon!
I feel sorry for whatever stray challenger ends up opposite to her in the arena!
That's all on today's Interview Intermission...
That's all on today's Interview Intermission. Until next time!
Yo, Reborn City! What's up?! We're here with the Reborn Rundown, giving you a look at the Leaders of the Reborn League!
I'm your host, DJ Arclight, now on air!
Let's talk about Julia, the Peridot Ward Leader.
Julia's a bombastic battling babe bursting onto the scene after having graduated from the Onyx Trainers' School.
With a history of leading Pokémon and cheerleading teams alike, any challenger is promised an exciting battle against her!
Her Electric-types fall right in line with this, beating down her competitors with a barrage of her signature "boomies".
Sonic Boom and Explosion attacks form the chorus of her routine, so any Trainers planning to take her on should be ready to take some hits!
Take particular care with her Electrode, whose lightning-fast Speed and set damage takes the battle to a crescendo in a blink!
Let's have a quick review of Head Instructor Florinia, Leader of the Onyx Trainers' School in the Onyx Ward.
Take notes!
Like any good principal, Florinia takes education and knowledge very seriously.
Her fighting style makes use of both weather and terrain to overwhelm her opponents in stall-tactics with residual damage effects.
Not only that, but her signature move, Nature Power, takes a brain to use.
Most Trainers know that the attack changes based on the environment, but can you match your moves to the field you're on?
You'll certainly need a tactical advantage to take on her star Pokémon, Cradily!
Taking center stage in her 'desert rose' fighting style, a Mono-Grass Sandstorm hybrid, Cradily requires either pure strength or pure cunning to take out.
Today, we're going to be taking a break from our usual programming to dive into some history!
Specifically, we'll be looking at the now-retired Poison Gym Leader of an era past, Corey Molinar!
An older man with more derision than a grandma at a metal show, this former star pours it on thick with the pessimism.
Not a whole lot is known about the man except that he appears to have some training as a pharmacist, and works in cooperation with Reborn City police supplying valuable forensic chemicals and advice.
Here's a scoop though-- some residents of the Beryl Ward, where he's known to live, report him frequently visiting and spending hours at the nearby cemetery!
But who could that be for?
Even I'm not sure.
If you ask me, someone oughta go smack a smile into him.
Life's too short to be moping around all the time, yanno?
Trainers, should you find yourself in a chance battle against the old Leader, be careful!
His Crobat is a speed demon, and its attacks are no laughing matter.
Take special care not to let it set up by keeping pressure on it with status moves or hard-hits.
Perseverance will always win the day in the face of pessimism!
Let's talk about Shelly, Leader of the Lapis Ward!
She's a timid soul with a passion for reading and knowledge.
In fact, it's rare to see the girl without her nose in a book, but it's paid off in spades.
All that studying means that she knows just what kind of tune to have her Bug-types play in any battle!
Shelly herself prefers Double Battles, using rain to cover her weaknesses and overwhelm the opponent.
Her signature Pokémon, Illumise and Volbeat, are the prelude and finale each to her tactical advantages,
So if you find yourself facing the bookworm, focus down her supports right away!
We've got some sort of mystery for you today, viewers.
Let's talk about Shade, the Ghost Gym Leader.
Most people aren't all that sure if Shade is human, a ghost himself, or maybe something else entirely!
Given that he rarely speaks, and that when he does, he seldom makes common sense, there's not a whole lot we can tell you about this entity.
In battle, look out for his ace Pokémon, Mimikyu!
That Pokémon hides nearly as much as the Leader himself does, but rather than a sinister smile to top it all off, Mimikyu's Disguise makes it hard to hit.
Do your best not to let it get the jump on you... or else!
Today, we're taking a hiatus from your regularly scheduled roster to visit another relic of Reborn's League History, Kiki Argall!
Now the modest Sensei of Apophyll Academy, Kiki was once a Fighting Gym Leader of some renown!
A devout teacher of zen philosophy, Kiki sings the melody that eases the mind and plays the beat to soothe the body.
Her special technique, honed even after her retirement, revolves around honing her Pokémon's power with mental focus,
And believe me, a Pokémon's power-packed pure Focus Punch isn't something any brawler can just shrug off.
Take special care with her Medicham!
Its Meditate attack will skyrocket its offensive capabilities, so make sure to take it down before it can set up!
Today, we're looking at Reborn's newest Leader, the poison-packing Aya!
A new star on the scene, Aya has recently replaced her own brother, Cain LaRue, who himself was a relatively recent arrival!
It seems between the two of them, they decided she's the better fit for the role of Gym Leader!
My sources tell me that Aya, who lives in the Byxbysion Wasteland, favors Double Battles,
And uses her signature move to throw all the putrid power of poison across the field at once.
Take care, or you really will be wasted!
Of course, none carries this task out better than her Dragalge.
Its Adaptability skill makes any hit sting, so KO that 'Mon ASAP.
Today we're looking at the Ice Gym Leader, Serra!
A former model, Miss Serra Voclain has made a career change and is now breaking up the battle scene.
For Trainers daring to bear Serra's feral onslaught, beware and take care to prepare for this icy hell of a fight!
Always one for keeping appearances, Serra's arena is covered top to bottom in mirrors.
Her stealthy Pokémon, notably Froslass, enjoy dancing in and out of the frames, both silver and glass, with a tinge of aurora for shine!
Defensive and sneaky plays are the name of her Pokémon's game, so reliable attacks or those that can shatter her screens can be your go-to!
Before going in, reflect on how you can see past her tactics and pin the pin-up model down!
Let's talk about Noel!
One of Reborn's youngest Leaders, this prodigy boy has an arena set up right below the Lapis Ward's Orphanage.
Noel's got a penchant for frustrating his unsuspecting challengers,
Who suppose either his youth or his Normal-type Pokémon will make for an easy match.
Not to be outdone so easily, Noel packs a medley of Pokémon that cover his weaknesses.
Including, to the surprise of many, his Clefable!
Though Clefable is no longer a Normal-type Pokémon, Noel is one of the few Leaders to use a wildcard in his battles.
Don't let yourself get stuck on this brick wall of a Pokémon, and do whatever it takes to take it out before it gets cozy in its defensive capability!
By the way, a few of our listeners have asked in the past about just how someone of Noel's age earned a position in the Reborn League.
Like any Leader, he was referred to the position and passed his qualifying tests-- with flying colors, no less!
But just who would refer him to such a position?
We'll give you just a small hint! All right, listen closely:
We've got a report on Grandmaster Radomus, Reborn's Psychic Leader!
Radomus is a cheery man with a fascination for assorted hats!
Ranging from fashionable to outright bizarre, his wardrobe and mannerisms toe the line between defying and defining logic!
Of course, as a Grandmaster of chess, his logic must be solid.
Having amassed a fortune from tournaments, he lives in his very own personal Castle, complete with a Chessboard Arena!
In battle, his Psychic abilities can shift the pieces around, including making them attack your own Pokémon.
Fight back by beating him at his own game!
His ace Pokémon is already well known herself, the one and only Gossip Gardevoir, who runs other segments on the network.
Her strength is matched only by her pep, so make sure you're ready when going into battle, otherwise you'll find yourself right in check by the two of them!
Let's talk about the Gym Leader, Luna!
Luna's a lovely lady with more than one way to make a man tremble.
If her beauty wasn't spell-binding alone, her Dark-type attacks will lock down and take out any opposition if unchecked.
And from being the Champion of Wonderland, to a regal lord's maid, Luna enjoys bringing infinity to reality by living out storybook tales.
Even her Pokémon are all named after characters from old fantasy!
As for what they are, we'll let you figure out the hard way.
After all, the Cheshire Cat himself was never too clear.
One-and-two, that's a knockout!
You'll hear this often when facing the Agate Circus Strongman, Samson!
Reborn's current Fighting Gym Leader, compared to the long past previous one, is all about matter over mind!
His Pokémon's power is augmented by the Big Top's High Striker effect, an infamously rigged carnival game that triggers based on certain attacks!
Here's a hook: It turns out, Samson may not have joined the League of his own accord.
It seems he was strong-armed into it by another party.
And who's that?
None other than the Agate Circus' Ground Leader, Terra!
What could have gone down?
The world may never know.
But in order to take him out, beat him at his own game!
Cripple his Pokémon to reduce their power-- even that from the High Striker-- or use the Big Top's Flying-type advantages for the super-effective kill!
Either way, Pokémon like his ace, Conkeldurr, are sure not to go down easy as they tank hits and strike back double every time!
Today, we're going over Charlotte, a young beauty as cool as she is hot!
Taking over her mother's Gym after years of absence, Charlotte's Super-heated Field offers little advantage itself to her Fire-types.
However, when ignited by her wide-ranged Fire attacks, the inferno takes a new life, and often a few other lives with it!
Trainers will need to keep the flames under wraps one way or another, or pack a team that can stand them!
The situation gets no more mild when her Ninetales enters the fray!
Its Drought Ability amplifies her strength even further, but keep in mind, every strategy has its exploits!
She's hearty, she's hyper, and she's abso-freaking- lutely insane--
Terra, the Ground Gym Leader, is up to play!
With a personality like an earthquake and a type to match, anyone who's met her-- is probably traumatized.
However, I wanted to find out what's really behind that energetic persona, so I did some digging to find out.
From the records I found, it looks like Terra was a fairly average girl at one point, having been raised in the Beryl Ward.
School reports say she was very shy, and seldom socialized, and took a natural interest in computer science.
One day, however, she ran away from home for a reason perhaps she only knows...
...and was next known applying for a job at the Agate Circus with her zany energetic persona!
Just what happened to her between the time she left home and the time she joined the Circus?
Call me crazy-- Actually, call her crazy,
But I'm not sure I want to find out.
Let's talk about the aerial Agate Ace, Ciel!
If you haven't seen her in action, then imagine this:
Two ribbons hang from the ceiling.
A dancer on the floor twirls herself betwixt them, over, under, and back again, spinning this way and that, pulling the ribbons ever tighter to her.
Then--
She jumps.
The ribbons unfurl around her body, lifting her up with their tension.
She grabs onto them, subtly climbing higher as she flips over, her legs dancing towards the sky.
